researcher_preview_exposures.mechanism: The dataset landing page automatically included row previews while checking the official release.
researcher_preview_exposures.note: Rows were partial previews, including a truncated final ID. No claim that the entire patch or all rows were inspected.

datasets.future_access_rule: Read version-pinned README/metadata; project public columns before any dataset row display. Do not use previewed solutions for task selection.
datasets.automated_selector_enforcement: prepare_pro_public_inputs.py rejects a screening plan that fails to exclude a recorded repository; no Pro trial is scheduled

instruction_exposures.scope: first twelve sorted train tasks, four scenarios; two variant-one tasks used in P6/P8/P10 development
next four scenarios selected by IDs before reading instructions, variant one only

datasets.generator_exposure: Only each current task and its own public observations. P11 completed all four; P12 reuses the same four for development. No cross-task evaluation or solution injection.
datasets.future_access_rule: Use the train ID list and public instruction field only for this selection. Do not invoke difficulty filters, read solution/ground-truth files, or select by outcomes. Keep all related variants outside untouched confirmation.
datasets.scope_note: Researcher has reviewed development outcomes for P6/P8; these tasks are not an untouched test set. This registry is not proof of model pretraining cleanliness.

researcher_preview_exposures.scope: Nine automatically displayed corpus excerpts in the metadata page, not query/evidence-label rows

datasets.future_access_rule: Pin revisions, precommit query ID selection before reading text, isolate answer/relevance columns from generator, retain full corpus and record all development exposures. No claim that pretrained models have never seen this benchmark.
